scope: Sony A6000 FW 3.21; static local analysis only; no camera interaction or binary modification.
method: static topology and extent evidence cross-check

findings.finding: ObjCamera constructor initializes object state, locks, resources and helpers without calling DmmCh, DmmAccessPLA or AvbbcPhycMem.
Nine 0x40-byte MWF ObjPin objects are constructed at this+0x58..this+0x78 with output direction.
Topology 0x0a connects ObjCamera out0 to ObjEffect in0.
ObjEffect/PbCap constructs DmmCh(0x35), calls allocNew twice, and builds ObjMsg(0x3900,0x3000); no static caller edge from ObjCamera was recovered.

findings.method: llvm-objdump plus prior DMM extent extraction
findings.finding: PbCap's known pair is raster unitType 0x50b3f / extent 0xed / 0x3fc000 bytes and SDS unitType 0xe0b00 / extent 0xe4 / 0x800 bytes. SDS is control metadata, not pixels.

findings.method: absence of a static sensor-register-to-Camera-descriptor chain
findings.finding: Sensor register dimensions cannot identify Camera YC size or geometry.
Camera YC unitType, DMM handle, offset, physical/DMA memory, geometry, pixel format, stride, planes, colorimetry, ownership and recycling policy remain unresolved.
Effect might allocate a later compatible DMM pair if a Live View path reaches its PbCap conversion, but neither reachability nor identity with the source Camera frame is proven.

safety: SilentShutter is not declared functional. No original binary was modified, no Ghidra project was deleted, and no camera was connected or flashed.
